questions.stem_text: Higher dietary sodium (salt) intake is generally associated with:

options.A: Decreased calcium excretion in the urine
options.D: Negative calcium balance and bone mineral loss

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Negative calcium balance and bone mineral loss

questions.stem_text:
The measurement of a specific biochemical status index for a micronutrient such as vitamin
C is most likely to be useful in practice to estimate:

options.A: The presence or risk of a clinical deficiency, such as clinical scurvy.
options.B: The overall quality of a person's diet
options.C: The tissue levels, or body status, of that nutrient.
options.D: Overall health and freedom from disease.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The tissue levels, or body status, of that nutrient.

questions.stem_text:
Which of two hormones act on the hypothalamus to increase satiety and hunger,
respectively?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Leptin and ghrelin

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements about glucose metabolism is correct?

options.A: Glucagon increases the rate of glycolysis
options.C: In glycolysis, glucose is cleaved into two three-carbon products
options.D: The end-product of glycolysis in red blood cells is pyruvate

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - In glycolysis, glucose is cleaved into two three-carbon products
